results.requirement: Customer mobile app exists and is Flutter-based.
Driver mobile app exists and is Flutter-based.
Admin dashboard exists and is Next.js-based.
Backend has the required service folders.
Flutter apps use clean architecture folders for features, data, domain, and presentation.
Flutter apps use Riverpod state management.
Flutter apps use GoRouter navigation.
Flutter apps use Dio networking.
Flutter apps support dark/light mode.
Email login and registration work from mobile apps through backend.
Phone OTP login and verification.
Google, Apple, and Facebook login integrations.
JWT auth, refresh tokens, and RBAC authorization.
Auth and user data persist in PostgreSQL, not in-memory arrays or maps.
Customer profile, photo, addresses, favorites, emergency contacts, and ride preferences.
Instant ride booking.
Scheduled ride booking.
Multi-stop, round trip, hourly rental, and ride pooling.
Vehicle categories: economy, bike, keke, sedan, SUV, luxury, courier, delivery van, truck.
Realtime GPS tracking and live driver movement.
Google Maps, ETA, route optimization, distance matrix, traffic, heat maps, and geofencing.
Dynamic pricing, surge pricing, zone pricing, and promo codes.
Wallet funding, withdrawals, transactions, refunds, cashback, and rewards.
Paystack, Flutterwave, Monnify, OPay, bank transfer, card, USSD, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and cash.
SOS, trip sharing, emergency contacts, and optional trip audio recording.
Rider and driver ratings and reviews.
Driver registration with NIN, BVN, license, vehicle documents, facial verification, and background check.
Driver dashboard: online/offline, ride requests, accept/reject, earnings, incentives, wallet, destination filter.
Smart queue, heat zones, Waze/Google navigation, scheduled ride acceptance, levels, bonuses, referrals.
Live operations panel with live map, active rides, drivers, riders, monitoring, cancel, reassign, ban.
Finance dashboard: revenue, commission, driver payouts, withdrawals, refunds, tax.
KYC approval, support ticketing, live support chat, disputes, call center panel.
Inter-state travel: shared/private travel, seat selection, luggage pricing, boarding points, route management, scheduled departures.
Customers can request nearby drivers and drivers can bid/offer negotiated pricing.
Socket.IO realtime system with Redis Pub/Sub for tracking, chat, ride status, and notifications.
AI dispatch matches nearest, best-rated, lowest ETA, lowest cancellation risk drivers.
AI surge pricing, demand prediction, fraud detection, GPS spoofing detection, wallet fraud detection.
PostgreSQL schema includes all required production tables, indexes, foreign keys, and constraints.
REST APIs are versioned, documented with Swagger, validated with DTOs, and have structured error handling.
Docker Compose runs core services with Postgres and Redis.
Kubernetes, NGINX, GitHub Actions, autoscaling, monitoring, logging, backups.
Unit, integration, E2E, API, and load tests exist.
